pwa.title: Bingo Royale on your device
pwa.description: Add it to your home screen for quick access.
pwa.helpIntro: Keep Bingo Royale one tap away.
pwa.ios1: Open this page in Safari and tap Share.
pwa.ios3: Keep Open as Web App enabled if shown, then tap Add.
pwa.other1: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen. On Safari for Mac, choose File → Add to Dock.
pwa.other2: Confirm to add Bingo Royale. If no install option appears, open this page in Chrome, Edge, or Safari.
pwa.onlineRequired: An internet connection is required for multiplayer games.
pwa.update: An update is ready. After your game, close all Bingo Royale tabs and app windows, then reopen.
pwa.offline: You’re offline. Reconnect to continue playing.
